frozen_sidecar.definition: Exact byte snapshot of the microscopic W bound for a future structural proposal. Theta is a prospective immutable sidecar alias and is not a new scientific primitive parameter.
frozen_sidecar.ordered_digest: domain-separated SHA-256 over ontology/version, primitive-contract digest, d, N, and canonical little-endian C-order Theta bytes

future_authority: This PASS authorizes only a separately prompted E0R2 representability test.

identity_semantics.equivalence: simultaneous permutation of frozen columns and participation states

materialization_semantics.ACTIVE: W_out[:,i] is copied exactly from frozen Theta[:,i]
materialization_semantics.DISABLED: W_out[:,i] is six exact binary64 +0.0 values
materialization_semantics.FROZEN_ZERO: W_out[:,i] remains the bound zero column and is not writable
materialization_semantics.reason_zero_is_ordinary_primitive_member: The primitive accepts W in R^(6 x N); phi(0)=0, so a zero column contributes zero to the existing raw additive sum.

structural_state.binding_initialization: Every exact numerically nonzero frozen Theta column begins ACTIVE. Every exact all-zero frozen column begins FROZEN_ZERO and is non-writable.
structural_state.writable_degree_class: one binary ACTIVE/DISABLED state per writable whole column
